iti97:2.1: kalyāṇasīlo bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇadhammo kalyāṇapañño imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapurisoti vuccati. 1
iti97:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pāṭimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
iti97:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇasīlo hoti.
iti97:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sattattiṃsabodhipakkhikānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto viharati
iti97:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇadhammo hoti.
iti97:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
iti97:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇapañño hoti.
iti97:6.1: iti kalyāṇasīlo kalyāṇadhammo kalyāṇapañño imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapurisoti vuccatīti.
